'''Kursav''' (also known as '''Faita''' or '''Kulsab''') is a divergent and nearly extinct [[Madang languages|Madang language]] of the [[Adelbert Range]] of [[Papua New Guinea]]. It was once placed in the now-defunct [[Brahman languages|Brahman]] branch of Madang. Daniels (2017) identifies [[Gants language|Gants]] as its closest relative.<ref>Daniels, Don. 2017. Gants is a Sogeram Language. ''Language and Linguistics in Melanesia'' 35: 82-93.</ref>
